_readme: Manual one-off special-request cards for the Warehouse Board (wall.html). A card shows while today's date is within [from, to] inclusive (YYYY-MM-DD). Fields: id (unique), lodge, kind (ownerout | ownerin | note | check), title, message (shown on the card), when (the date it happens, shown as a relative label like 'Tomorrow'), from, to. Use this for TRUE one-offs; recurring per-lodge rules (e.g. owner-self-clean lodges) live in lodge_rules.json instead. Edit and commit to update the board; delete an entry once it's done.
